heroSubheading: Sales, servicing, and advice on major brands you trust
aboutHtml:
We're Martin and Deborah Leach, the owners of STIHL SHOP Napier. We know STIHL inside and out—everything from online sales to mechanical servicing and repairs. We also stock other major outdoor power brands: Masport, Cub Cadet, Honda, Hansa Chippers, Lawnmaster, and Weber BBQs.

Come in for equipment, parts, repairs, or advice from people who actually know what they're doing. Whether you're after a new piece of equipment or your current one needs servicing, we can help. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, weekends 9am to 3pm.

We're proud sponsors of the Magpies Rugby Club, Art Deco Golf Tournament, Hohepa Foundation, and Napier City Gardening competition. Napier's our home, and we're always here to help when you need us.
whatMakesUsSpecial: Sponsor local rugby, golf, and gardening
